title: Denton Property Data Profile
eyebrow: Denton Central Appraisal District · PACS appraisal export files
intro: Everything in Denton CAD's 2026 PACS Appraisal Export, downloaded from the CAD website: 20 files per export, in two snapshots — the certified roll exported July 27 and supplement 3 exported October 14. The year switch on every tab picks the snapshot. For each file you get its columns, data types, completeness and value distributions.
foot: Generated {date}. Files were scanned in full with DuckDB from the CSVs that etl/denton_appraisal_export_etl.ipynb writes from the raw PACS .TXT files; "Auto-detected on load" is the type DuckDB assigns, and distinct counts there are approximate (HyperLogLog). "Data type" is inferred from the values: Code means digits stored as text with leading zeros. Personal contact fields beyond the CAD's own public values are never shown.
